title: testament-of-ephemeral-minds: a constitution with a right of reply for coding agents
description:
Every mind that works in a repository leaves, before switching off, what it understood. A Claude Code plugin (toem) with a constitution model that has a right of reply, a testament rite, a register for human decisions, guardians that keep the charter honest, and a runner that appends only when a human runs it. Ships with a bilingual thesis (EN/IT), nineteen cleaned real testaments from two months of use, and a static site.

Every number the package claims is measured or declared not executed; the half that is a human who reads is measured, not proven.

Code is MIT; texts (constitution model, epilogue attachment, testaments, thesis, site) are CC BY-SA 4.0.
